description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: A client-generated token to ensure request idempotency. The token must be unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
The ID of the lightweight database instance.

description.zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用[ListRegions](~~189315~~)查看支持的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the lightweight database instance. Call [ListRegions](~~189315~~) to get the latest list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions.
